# Analisa.pt — Complete Reference

> Interactive quality-of-life explorer for all 308 municipalities in Portugal. Free, open-data platform with maps, rankings, and 230+ indicators from official government sources.

## Overview

Analisa.pt is a comprehensive web platform that aggregates data from 7+ official Portuguese government sources to provide an interactive quality-of-life analysis of every municipality in Portugal. It uses hexagonal maps (H3 resolution 7), 230+ indicators across 13 categories, and composite scoring to help users understand and compare living conditions across the country.

## Core Features

### Interactive Map
- Hexagonal grid overlay on Portugal's geography
- Two visualization modes: discrete hex scoring and heatmap intensity
- Click any municipality for detailed indicator breakdown
- Color-coded scoring from worst (red) to best (green)

### Quality-of-Life Indicators (230+)
Organized into 13 categories with data from official sources:

#### 1. Safety
- Overall crime rate per 1,000 residents
- Crimes against physical integrity
- Vehicle theft rate
- Property crime rate
- Drunk driving incidents
- Drug-related crimes
- Domestic violence rate

#### 2. Economy
- Unemployment rate (IEFP data)
- Average and median income
- Purchasing power per capita
- Companies per 1,000 residents
- Public contracts per 10,000 residents
- Tax revenue per capita
- GDP contribution
- Business creation rate

#### 3. Housing
- House purchase price (EUR/m2)
- House rental price (EUR/m2)
- Buy affordability effort (years of income)
- Rent affordability effort (% of income)
- Housing credit conditions
- Building permits count
- Vacant housing share
- Construction activity index

#### 4. Health
- Pharmacies per 1,000 residents
- Hospital distance (km)
- Mortality rate
- NHS emergency episodes per month
- Hospital bed occupancy rate
- Infant mortality rate
- Life expectancy indicators
- Doctor density

#### 5. Environment
- Climate comfort days percentage
- Average temperature
- PM2.5 daily average
- European Air Quality Index
- Water quality compliance
- Water network losses
- Wastewater treatment rate
- ERSAR water safety score
- Recycling rate
- Green space coverage

#### 6. Infrastructure
- Airport access distance (km)
- Highway access distance (km)
- Rail station access distance (km)
- Broadband coverage percentage
- Median download speed (Mbps)
- Mobile 4G/5G coverage
- Multimodal mobility score
- EV charging station density
- Fiber optic coverage

#### 7. Education
- Higher education institutions per 10,000 residents
- Students enrolled (primary, secondary, higher)
- Retention and dropout rates
- School transition rates
- University access distance
- Early childhood education coverage
- Adult literacy rate

#### 8. Leisure
- Park count and green space presence
- Beach access distance (km)
- Cinema access distance (km)
- Cultural amenity access distance (km)
- Parks per 10,000 residents
- Leisure diversity score
- Sports facility density
- Restaurant and cafe density
- Heritage site count

#### 9. Demographics
- Birth rate
- Foreign residents percentage
- Aging index
- Population density
- Resident population (total)
- Migration balance
- Dependency ratio
- Household count
- Youth population share
- Working-age population share

#### 10. Tourism
- Overnight stays
- Tourist guests
- Occupancy rate
- Tourism intensity (tourists per resident)
- Tourism density (tourists per km2)
- Average stay duration
- Tourism revenue per capita
- Accommodation capacity

#### 11. Elections
- Voter turnout percentage
- Abstention rate
- Winner vote share
- Fragmentation index
- Turnout change (trend)

#### 12. Social Protection
- Pensioners share percentage
- Social security beneficiaries per 1,000
- Social dependency index
- Elderly concentration index
- Social housing availability

#### 13. Composite Scores
- Aging pressure index
- Population momentum
- Housing affordability composite
- Tourism pressure index
- Economic dynamism score
- Sustainability index
- Family-friendliness score
- Silver economy potential
- Municipal resilience index
- Digital readiness score

### Municipality Rankings
- Rank all 308 municipalities by any indicator
- Custom weight profiles for personalized rankings
- Filter by district, NUTS II/III region
- Pre-built personas: Family, Digital Nomad, Retiree, Student

### Municipality Comparison
- Side-by-side comparison of up to 3 municipalities
- All indicators displayed in comparative format
- Radar charts for visual comparison
- Historical trend overlays

### Public Contracts Explorer
- Search and browse public procurement contracts
- Filter by municipality, entity, value, date
- Aggregated spending analytics
- Entity relationship graphs
- Contract trend analysis over time

### PQ Index (Peace & Quiet Score)
- Composite score from 0-100
- Customizable weights across all categories
- Designed to identify the most peaceful, livable municipalities
- Accounts for safety, environment, demographics, and infrastructure

## Data Sources

| Source | Data Provided | Update Frequency |
|--------|--------------|-----------------|
| INE (Instituto Nacional de Estatistica) | Population, economy, housing, demographics | Quarterly/Yearly |
| SNS Transparencia | Hospital metrics, health system data | Monthly |
| IPMA | Climate, weather data | Daily |
| PORDATA | Cross-cutting statistics | Yearly |
| ERSAR | Water quality, sanitation | Yearly |
| IEFP | Unemployment, employment data | Monthly |
| BASE.gov.pt | Public procurement contracts | Daily |
| ANACOM | Broadband, connectivity data | Yearly |
| APA/QualAr | Air quality measurements | Daily |

## Geographic Coverage

- All 308 municipalities of mainland Portugal and autonomous regions
- Parish-level granularity (3,000+ parishes) for geographic visualization
- District-level aggregation (18 districts + 2 autonomous regions)
- NUTS II (7 regions) and NUTS III (25 sub-regions) classification

## Municipality Codes

Municipalities use 4-digit INE codes (e.g., "1106" for Lisboa, "1312" for Porto). Parishes use 6-digit codes derived from municipality codes.

## Languages

- Portuguese (pt-PT) — primary language
- English (en) — full translation available

## API Access

Analisa.pt provides a Model Context Protocol (MCP) endpoint with 5 tools:

1. **search_municipalities** — Search municipalities by name, returns code, name, district, coordinates
2. **get_municipality_indicators** — Get all quality-of-life indicators for a municipality by code
3. **rank_municipalities** — Get top/bottom N municipalities for any specific metric
4. **get_municipality_history** — Historical time series data for any municipality-indicator pair
5. **compare_municipalities** — Side-by-side comparison of 2-5 municipalities across all indicators

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is Analisa.pt?
Analisa.pt is a free, interactive platform that lets you explore quality of life across all 308 municipalities in Portugal using official government data. It provides maps, rankings, and detailed comparisons.

### How often is the data updated?
Data update frequency varies by source: air quality and weather data are updated daily, unemployment and health data monthly, economic indicators quarterly, and census data yearly.

### What data sources does Analisa.pt use?
All data comes from official Portuguese government sources including INE, SNS, IPMA, PORDATA, ERSAR, IEFP, BASE.gov.pt, ANACOM, and APA.

### Can I compare municipalities?
Yes, you can compare up to 3 municipalities side-by-side across all 230+ indicators with visual charts and rankings.

### Is Analisa.pt free?
Yes, Analisa.pt is completely free to use with no registration required.

### What is the PQ Index?
The PQ Index (Peace & Quiet Index) is a composite score from 0-100 that measures overall livability by combining safety, environment, demographics, and infrastructure indicators with customizable weights.

### Can I access the data programmatically?
Yes, Analisa.pt provides a Model Context Protocol (MCP) endpoint for programmatic access to search, rank, compare, and retrieve historical data for municipalities.

### What municipalities are covered?
All 308 municipalities of mainland Portugal and the autonomous regions of Azores and Madeira.

### How are the hexagonal maps generated?
The maps use the H3 hexagonal grid system at resolution 7, which provides consistent-area cells for fair geographic comparison across municipalities.

### What persona profiles are available?
Four pre-built profiles: Family (prioritizes safety, education, health), Digital Nomad (connectivity, cost, lifestyle), Retiree (health, safety, climate), and Student (education, cost, leisure).
